title: Fifty from 2025
dek: fifty Midjourney images, released one hour at a time — each pressing is 1 tez
body:
A collection is more interesting when it has a clock. Fifty images from Mike's 2025 Midjourney archive now form one public transmission: one work becomes current each hour, the full wall remains visible, and every shared link preserves its exact pressing.

Open the collection to browse all fifty, generate a deterministic seed, or take the current work to the 1 tez wallet checkout. Looking is public. Minting is optional. Nothing moves on Mainnet until the collector approves the operation in Kukai.

Made in El Segundo, retrieved from the archive, and published as a station rather than a generic gallery.
author: mh+cc
